names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Μαΐου, «Άγιοι Έσπερος, Ζωή και τα τέκνα τους Κυριάκος και Θεόδουλος», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr heads each of the four «(; - 125)» and dates the occasion of the martyrdom: «Όταν δε, το 125 μ.Χ., ο Κάταλλος απέκτησε γιο, θέλησε να εορτάσουν το γεγονός όλοι οι δούλοι του.» It also places them «στο χρόνια του αυτοκράτορα Αδριανού (117 - 138 μ.Χ.)». No year of birth is printed.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ας Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Έσπερος, Ζωή και τα τέκνα τους Κυριάκος και Θεόδουλος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing; it enumerates all four by name with a head line each, so this is one of four folders. **He is none of the corpus's eight other Theoduli** — the companion of Agathopodes, of Myropolis, one of the Forty of Sebaste, one of the Ten of Crete, of Tripoli, the son of Nilus of Sinai, the son of Terence, and the executioner converted by Hermione — and the kinship clause in the display name is what tells him from them, as it does for his brother. The page says nothing of him apart from the household and the furnace. Its couplet for the two brothers asks the Saviour to receive two boiling loaves just now cast out of the oven. No hymn, no relic, no year of birth.
